Disaster Evacuation Information
Emergency Ready App provides multilingual support in English, Chinese, and Japanese for 36 services, including disaster alerts, safety guide, and civil defense shelter locations.
Service
Disaster alerts, safety guide, civil defense shelter locations, fire reports, and information on embassies, fire stations, police stations, and emergency medical centers, etc.

(Configuration) Select your region, disaster alert settings, and language
*
